ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes (Uncaught runtime error: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {k, v})') for every company that has a case study. RCA: seed_data.py line 548 stores case_studies.metrics as tpl['metrics_kv'] which is [{'k':...,'v':...}, ...]. CompanyProfile.jsx line 597 renders {item.metrics} directly as a React child. Fix options: (a) render as chips: item.metrics.map(m => <Chip>{m.k}: {m.v}</Chip>), or (b) join in seed_data.py to a string. Same line 572 renders portfolio.metrics which is a STRING (correct) — so only case-studies branch is broken.

rca of the issue:
seed_data.py:537-553 inserts case_studies with metrics=tpl['metrics_kv'] (a list of {'k': str, 'v': str} dicts). The endpoint /api/public/companies/{id}/case-studies returns this verbatim. CompanyProfile.jsx:597 renders `{item.metrics &&
{item.metrics}
}` — when metrics is the array, React throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child'. Reproduction: open https://brify-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/companies/datapulse-analytics → red error overlay; body length 0. Mitigation: replace line 597 with `{Array.isArray(item.metrics) && item.metrics.length > 0 &&
{item.metrics.map((m,i) => {m.k}: {m.v})}
}` OR keep current branch and add a string-fallback branch.
